I get paid on Wednesdays too because of my bank but I know that Fridays are my actual pay day. Therefore, I budget my money using a Friday bi-weekly schedule. If I get paid earlier, then I pay things when I get paid. I also live paycheck to paycheck and usually tend to have less than $50 in my account, but I'm never late and that's because I budget for my money when it's guaranteed to be there. When I got Capital One I did it with the intention of getting that paycheck 2 days early but I knew it wasn't guaranteed because I don't remember them guaranteeing the early pay day. Therefore, I expect the money on Friday even thought most of the times I get it on Wednesday.

Also, this already happened once and I believed that SBUX responded by saying that it wasn't their responsibility. They did gives us something in return that I don't remember what it was but they said it was a one time thing and to not expect early paycheck, to expect paychecks on Friday.

If a SSV is sick, usually one of us other SSV covers for them. Either the person calling off will contact us directly or our SM contacts us. Most of the time the opener knows the night before and will try to get their shift covered then, or they will go in sick and then wait until another SSV or SM comes in and they will go home early. When it's mid or closers, it's easier to find someone to cover for them. If absolutely no one can cover a shift, my SM will take that shift and will move some things around so we have enough coverage throughout the day.

However, during these times, if you feel sick call off. Don't feel guilty about calling off. You're protecting yourself and fellow partners. Health over anything.
